objectives: minimise global fixed-start IK failure fraction

search.nsga: 32 population +7 offspring batches32; SBX p=.9 eta15; polynomial mutation per-variable1/7 eta20; feasibility-first rank/crowding; common Sobol initial32 including references
search.staged: Common initial32 +128 Sobol +32 curvature grids (4x4 around each reference) +64 local proposals around4 development leaders
search.dense_allowance: 4 distinct candidates/run; references extra equal shared overhead
search.comparison: Same objectives/guards/fidelity, not an exact rerun of historical hand-weighted scoring
search.stop: 256 evaluator slots after analytic feasibility filtering; same Sobol rejection-replacement rule for both methods; log rejected proposals, cache hits, sampler failures and actual time separately.
search.proposal_replacement: 8192-point scrambled Sobol reserve seeded run_seed+900; replace analytically infeasible geometry before evaluator. NSGA-II receives repaired design coordinates.

evaluation.fixed_start: Existing most-retracted feasible exterior decode([0,0,0]), zero rotations; unchanged40-iteration DLS
evaluation.path_initialisation: Existing two-nearest-start diagnostic,60 iterations each; same for all geometries; no recovery
evaluation.paths: Original feasible joint-linear shortest-angle paths; 21 waypoints,40 iterations/warm-start; 4 checks/segment screen,100 checks/segment final; dense maximum must<=0.5mm
evaluation.global_targets: Annular-volume-proportional cell draws, random full-azimuth original-FK points; no hidden canonical-plane targets
evaluation.rotation: Unrestricted middle/outer rotation; inner straight rotation has no effect
evaluation.isotropy: Existing fixed range-scaled positional Jacobian; missing/low-support cell values zero; fixed original region denominators

statistical_rule: IK gain>=3pp and paired95% interval lower>0; regional interval lower>=-2pp. Path observed completion>=baseline AND conservative paired-binomial difference lower>=-2pp. P95 path-block bootstrap upper increase<=.05mm. Coverage robust supported-reference loss<=2% in each equal-budget repeat and resolution sensitivity; if sampling calibration cannot resolve2%, coverage is inconclusive, not relaxed. Reach/isotropy point margins required in both repeats; sampling sensitivity reported. All gates conjunctions; no validation tuning.
classification: accepted only if selection and all final gates pass; failed or inconclusive otherwise. Two frozen method champions evaluated; Bonferroni intervals97.5% for their statistical gates. Three seeds descriptive, not universal algorithm superiority.
assumptions: Lengths provisional chuck-tip-to-distal-tip material lengths; no35mm offset
Curves beyond maximum exposure exterior-equivalent; material choices not interchangeable physically
No manufacture-certified bounds, torsion, friction, elastic stability, contact, physical measurement or clinical validation
historical: All previously inspected results are development evidence; reserved seeds not opened until champions frozen
